svg.title: Port Haverford Harbour District: 1995 vs. Present Day
svg.desc: Two side-by-side comparison maps showing the redevelopment of the coastal district of Port Haverford from an industrial harbour surrounded by woodland and farmland in 1995 to a residential, leisure, educational, and commercial waterfront at the present day.
svg.text: Port Haverford Harbour District: 1995 vs. Present Day
Southern coastline faces the harbour · Main Coastal Road runs East–West across the centre
